'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex W DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex W]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
